correctness.rationale: The proof establishes a nonscalar two-by-two compression for independent A,B with rank A>=2 by Hahn–Banach, constructs an explicit involution H with nonzero mixed trace, and exhibits T=UHV of rank exactly 2. For any nonzero pencil coefficient pair, H(lambda I+mu M) has a nonzero eigenvalue by trace or involution. Every rank-one candidate misses a nonzero pencil member by the trace kernel. Rank<=1 pencils admit no multiplier of any rank. The continuity argument works after real complexification. 309 exact-arithmetic cases/9888 assertions passed as diagnostics, not as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural input gap is the unspecified finite rank of the common multiplier in Aznay–Chabbabi Lemma 3.2. A sharp absolute rank bound is consequential: all operator pencils with a rank>=2 member have a rank-two common spectral detector, none have rank-one, and low-rank pencils cannot be detected at any rank. The constructive 2x2 compression gives stable separation and works without geometric ambient assumptions; it answers a structural and quantitative question, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
